trophies.name: Leonida Legend
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of the whole guide: finish the story, clear every heist, collect everything, and work through the activities below. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order — story first, then collectibles while you explore, then the grind trophies last. Nothing here is missable except the two flagged story choices, so you can mop up in free roam after the credits.
sources: Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website
Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5

trophies.name: Vice City Royalty
trophies.description: Complete the story of Lucia Caminos and Jason Duvall.
trophies.guide: Play through every story mission from Lucia's release to the final score. There is no difficulty requirement, so play on whatever setting you enjoy. The story opens up the whole map as you go; side content can wait until after the credits. The final mission unlocks once every preceding story mission is done.
sources: Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website
Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5

trophies.name: One Hundred Percent Leonida
trophies.description: Reach 100 percent game completion.
trophies.guide: Open the pause menu stats page to see what still counts: story missions, heists, stranger missions, races, stunt jumps, collectibles, activities and properties all feed the percentage. Work through this guide's checklist section by section and the counter climbs with you. The last few percent are almost always a stray collectible or an unfinished race series, so check the stats page before hunting blind.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats and completion screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Kingpin's Vault
trophies.description: Complete every major heist in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Each heist unlocks through the story and through contacts Lucia and Jason meet along the way. Every heist has a planning stage — pick your approach, gather the prep jobs, then run the score. You can replay heists after finishing them, so a failed run costs nothing but time. The last heist only appears once the story has reached its final act.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Leonida Explorer
trophies.description: Discover every named location across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Drive, fly or sail to each named place on the map — Vice City, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga, the Leonida Keys and the wetlands all count. A location registers the moment its name appears on screen. Use a fast car on the highways and a plane for the far corners; the map fills in as you pass through, and the stats page shows how many locations remain. Mop up the last few by flying a slow loop around the map edge — the stragglers are usually small settlements, not cities.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map and stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Collector Supreme
trophies.description: Find every collectible set hidden across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the long hunt: hidden packages, postcards, vinyl records and buried treasure, spread from Vice Beach to the swamps. Clear one set at a time and tick them off in this guide's checklist as you go — the in-game counter per set tells you how many are left. A helicopter makes the remote ones far quicker, and most sets are easiest after the story when the whole map is open.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game collectible counters
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Friends in Low Places
trophies.description: Complete every stranger and freaks mission in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stranger missions appear as question marks on the map and through phone messages from odd characters you meet. Some only show up at certain times of day or after a story beat, so keep checking the map between missions. Each one is short and self-contained; finish the lot and the trophy pops. If a marker will not appear, advance the story one mission and look again.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game mission list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Full Throttle
trophies.description: Win every race series and complete every stunt jump in Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are street, off-road and boat race series plus a set of stunt jumps scattered around Vice City and the Keys. For races, learn the track on the first lap and use the fastest vehicle class allowed; you can retry a race as often as you like. For stunt jumps, hit the ramp at full speed in a fast car and land all four wheels — a jump counts once the landing registers. The stats page tracks both.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Empire Builder
trophies.description: Own every business in Leonida and bring each one to maximum standing.
trophies.guide: Businesses unlock through story contacts and through cash: buy them from the property listings on your phone, then run their supply and sales missions to raise their standing. Each business pays out regularly once it is running, which funds the next purchase. Max standing takes a handful of missions per business, so rotate between them rather than grinding one at a time.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game property listings
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Fresh Out
trophies.description: Lucia walks free — complete the prologue.
trophies.guide: The prologue teaches the basics: follow the on-screen prompts through Lucia's release and the drive that follows. There is nothing to fail here that the game does not let you retry on the spot. The trophy pops at the end of the opening sequence.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Partners in Crime
trophies.description: Pull off your first job together as Lucia and Jason.
trophies.guide: This unlocks early in the story when the two leads team up for their first score. Follow the mission markers and the plan the game lays out — the job is scripted, so just play it through. Switching between Lucia and Jason during the job is part of the fun, not a requirement.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Back in the Game
trophies.description: Return to Vice City and set up the crew's new base.
trophies.guide: Story mission in the first act: drive into Vice City, meet the contact who sets you up, and claim the safehouse. The trophy pops once the base is established and the open world unlocks properly. From here the map starts to fill with side content.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: The Leonida Job
trophies.description: Complete your first major score.
trophies.guide: Your first big heist: finish the prep jobs the game offers first — they make the score itself far easier — then run the job. If you fail a phase, the game restarts you at the last checkpoint. The trophy pops when the crew gets away clean.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Trouble in Paradise
trophies.description: Survive the ambush on the Keys run.
trophies.guide: A story mission in the Keys turns into an ambush halfway through. Stick to cover, use the weapon the game hands you, and follow Jason's lead on when to move. The sequence is scripted, so the trophy pops once you fight clear and reach the getaway boat.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Family Business
trophies.description: Bring a family member into the crew.
trophies.guide: A story mission where Lucia leans on family to solve a problem the crew cannot buy its way out of. Play through the conversation and the job that follows. The trophy pops at the mission's end; the choice of how to handle the mark is yours, but the trophy pops either way.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: The Long Con
trophies.description: Run a con that takes all week to set up.
trophies.guide: This multi-stage story mission strings several small jobs together into one long con. Complete each stage in order — the game will not let you skip ahead — and keep an eye on the plan board between stages. The trophy pops when the mark finally hands over the prize.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: No Way Back
trophies.description: Cross the line that ends the crew's old life.
trophies.guide: The midpoint twist of the story: a mission where Lucia and Jason commit to something they cannot undo. It is a story beat, not a skill check — play the mission through and the trophy pops at the cutscene that follows. From here the second half of the story opens up.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Vice City Nights
trophies.description: Own the night in Vice City.
trophies.guide: A story mission set across one long night in the city — clubs, rooftops and a chase through Ocean Drive. Follow the markers and enjoy the ride; the trophy pops when dawn breaks over the mission's final scene.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: The Final Score
trophies.description: Complete the last heist of the story.
trophies.guide: The final heist is the biggest job in the game and the climax of the story. Do every prep job first — they unlock better gear and an easier escape — then run the score. This is the last story mission before the finale; the trophy pops as the crew splits the take.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Welcome to Vice City
trophies.description: Set foot in Vice City for the first time.
trophies.guide: Drive or fly into Vice City proper and the location name appears on screen — that is all it takes. It happens naturally in the story, but you can also trigger it in free roam by crossing into the city limits from the mainland.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Swamp Fox
trophies.description: Explore the Leonida wetlands by airboat.
trophies.guide: Head into the wetlands south of the mainland and take an airboat — they are parked at the docks and shacks along the water. Cruise through the swamp until the area name registers and the trophy pops. Watch for alligators in the water; they are scenery until you get too close.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Keys to the City
trophies.description: Visit every district of Vice City.
trophies.guide: Vice City is split into districts — Ocean Beach, Downtown, Little Haiti, Viceport and more. Drive through each one until its name shows on screen. The map tracks visited areas, so use this guide's checklist to tick them off and mop up whichever district you have missed.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Beach Bum
trophies.description: Spend a full in-game day at Vice Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Vice Beach, stay on the sand or the boardwalk, and let a full in-game day pass — around 48 real minutes at normal speed. You can swim, sunbathe, people-watch or just idle; the game counts time spent in the beach area. Sleeping at a nearby safehouse does not count, so stay on the beach itself.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Island Hopper
trophies.description: Visit every island of the Leonida Keys.
trophies.guide: The Keys stretch southwest of the mainland — take a boat or a plane and land on each island until its name registers. A fast boat from the Vice City marina covers the chain in one trip. The trophy pops when the last island's name appears.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game map
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Club Champion
trophies.description: Win the nightclub dance-off three nights in a row.
trophies.guide: Head to a nightclub in Vice City after dark and join the dance-off on the floor — follow the rhythm prompts as they appear. Win once, then come back on the next two in-game nights and win again. The trophy pops on the third straight win; losing a night resets the streak, so practise the timing first.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Gone Fishin'
trophies.description: Catch five fish from the Leonida waterways.
trophies.guide: Buy a fishing rod from a sporting goods store, then find a pier, a dock or a quiet stretch of swamp. Cast, wait for the tug, and reel in with steady tension — let the line go slack and the fish escapes. Any five fish count, from the canals to the open sea.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Fairway to Heaven
trophies.description: Complete a full round of golf under par.
trophies.guide: The golf course sits north of Vice City. Play all 18 holes and finish under par — take your time with the aiming line on each shot and use a gentle touch on the greens. You can retry the round as often as you like; the trophy pops the moment a completed round finishes under par.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Pool Shark
trophies.description: Win a game of pool without scratching once.
trophies.guide: Find a pool table in a bar — there is one in the crew's neighbourhood and several around Vice City. Play a full game against the AI and pocket the 8-ball last without ever sinking the cue ball. Take slow, aimed shots; a scratch ends the attempt, but you can start a new game immediately.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Dart Master
trophies.description: Win a game of darts with a checkout of 170.
trophies.guide: Darts boards hang in bars across Leonida. Play a game of 501 and finish it with the perfect checkout — treble 20, treble 20, bullseye. Aim carefully and use the practice throws to learn the timing. The trophy pops the moment the 170 checkout lands.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Gym Rat
trophies.description: Reach maximum strength at the gym.
trophies.guide: Visit a gym in Vice City and work the weights and the heavy bag regularly. Strength rises a little each session, so fold a workout into your routine between missions — a few sessions a week of game time. Max strength also makes melee fights noticeably easier.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Hunting Season
trophies.description: Hunt and bag five different wild animals in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Take a rifle into the wetlands and the forests around Mount Kalaga. Deer, boar, alligators and birds all count — five different species, not five kills of the same one. Use the hunting scope to spot animals at range and aim for a clean shot; the stats page lists which species you have bagged.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Snap Happy
trophies.description: Photograph ten different wild animals with your phone.
trophies.guide: Open your phone camera and snap ten different species in the wild — the wetlands and the beaches are the easiest hunting grounds. The photo counts when the animal is framed and in focus; you do not need to get close, the zoom helps. Check the stats page for which species you still need.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Most Wanted
trophies.description: Reach a five-star wanted level.
trophies.guide: Cause chaos in a busy part of Vice City — take out police cars, keep moving, and the stars climb. Five stars brings helicopters and roadblocks, so grab a fast car before you start. The trophy pops the instant the fifth star lights up.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Clean Getaway
trophies.description: Escape a five-star wanted level alive.
trophies.guide: First reach five stars, then break line of sight: lose the helicopters in the tunnels under Vice City or in the swamp backroads, and stay out of the search cones on the minimap until the stars flash and clear. A fast car with full armour helps, and the Pay 'n' Spray is not an option at five stars — you have to outrun them.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Headshot Hero
trophies.description: Land 100 headshots.
trophies.guide: A cumulative counter across the whole game — story shootouts, heists and free-roam gunfights all count. Aim for the head with a rifle or pistol and the counter climbs; it pops at 100. If you want it fast, replay a shootout-heavy mission, but most players earn it naturally before the finale.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Wheelman
trophies.description: Drive 500 miles across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Pure mileage: every mile you drive counts, in missions and in free roam. Highway runs between Vice City and the north of the map rack up distance fast — the long bridge and causeway stretch is the best place to cruise without stopping. The stats page shows your total — most players cross 500 miles well before finishing the story.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Air Support
trophies.description: Fly a plane under ten bridges in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Take a small plane from the Vice City airport and thread it under the bridges crossing the bay and the river — ten different bridges count. Fly low and slow, and use a plane with good handling rather than a jet. The counter ticks each time you pass cleanly under a new bridge.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Off-Road King
trophies.description: Win an off-road race in the Leonida backcountry.
trophies.guide: Off-road races start at markers in the hills and wetlands. Bring a truck or buggy with good suspension — the game lets you pick your vehicle at the start line. Cut corners where the track allows and keep your speed through the mud sections; one win is all it takes.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Street Racer
trophies.description: Win a street race in Vice City.
trophies.guide: Street races run at night from markers around the city. Bring the fastest car you own and learn the route on the first attempt — the checkpoints are generous and you can retry instantly. Win once and the trophy pops; winning the whole series counts toward Full Throttle.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Boat Captain
trophies.description: Win a boat race off the Leonida coast.
trophies.guide: Boat races launch from the marina and run around buoys off Vice Beach and the Keys. Speedboats handle the turns best — brake before the buoys rather than during them. One win pops the trophy, and the full series feeds into Full Throttle.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Postcard Perfect
trophies.description: Find ten postcards hidden around Vice City.
trophies.guide: Postcards are tucked onto noticeboards, shop counters and beach huts across the city — they glow faintly when you are close. Ten of them count for this trophy, and the full set feeds Collector Supreme. Work district by district so you do not cover the same streets twice.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game collectible counters
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Treasure Hunter
trophies.description: Dig up a buried treasure on the Leonida coast.
trophies.guide: Treasure maps are found as collectibles first — each map points to an X on a beach or island. Follow the map to the spot, use the shovel prompt, and dig. The first chest you open pops the trophy; more chests are hidden for the full collectible set.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game collectible counters
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Record Collector
trophies.description: Find five vinyl records hidden in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Vinyl records hide in record shops, clubs and apartments around Vice City. They sit on shelves and turntables and glint when you are near. Five count for this trophy; the full set is part of Collector Supreme. Check the shops first — several are in plain sight.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game collectible counters
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Hidden Stash
trophies.description: Find ten hidden packages across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Hidden packages are stashed in alleys, under piers, on rooftops and in the swamps — they glow faintly at close range. Ten count here; the full set feeds Collector Supreme. A helicopter and this guide's checklist make the sweep far quicker than wandering on foot.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game collectible counters
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Social Butterfly
trophies.description: Meet every contact and hang out with each of them once.
trophies.guide: Contacts unlock through the story and hand out hangout invites by phone. Accept each one — a drink, a drive, a game of pool — and the contact counts as met. The phone's contact list shows who you have hung out with, so work down the list between missions.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game phone contacts
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Night Owl
trophies.description: Stay out in Vice City from midnight to dawn.
trophies.guide: Be on foot or in a car in the city between midnight and 6am in-game time — the clock in the corner of the screen shows it. Visit a club, a diner or just cruise Ocean Drive; the trophy pops at dawn. Do not sleep or start a mission that jumps time forward, or the streak breaks.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game clock
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Big Spender
trophies.description: Spend one million dollars across Leonida.
trophies.guide: A lifetime spending counter — cars, clothes, weapons, properties and businesses all count. Heist payouts make this easy late in the story; the fastest route is buying a property or a top-end car once the money is there. The stats page shows your running total.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game stats screen
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Animal Lover
trophies.description: Befriend a stray dog in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stray dogs wander the neighbourhoods and the beaches. Approach one slowly, then use the interact prompt to pet it — repeat visits build trust until the dog follows you. The trophy pops when a dog becomes your companion for the first time.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game activity list
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Loose Ends
trophies.description: Settle the score with the informant — your way.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE: during the late-story mission where the crew corners the informant, you are given a choice — spare them or settle it permanently. This trophy requires sparing them and letting them walk away. The choice cannot be revisited after the mission ends, so make a manual save before starting the mission and reload if you pick the other option. The trophy pops in the mission's closing scene.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Storm Chaser
trophies.description: Survive a hurricane in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Hurricanes roll through Leonida in the storm season — the weather warning appears on your phone and the sky turns dark. Stay outside through the worst of it rather than sheltering indoors; driving through the storm in a sturdy vehicle works. The trophy pops once the storm passes while you are still out in it.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game weather system
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Party Animal
trophies.description: Attend a party at a crew safehouse.
trophies.guide: After certain story beats the crew throws a party at the safehouse — a phone message invites you. Show up, mingle, and stay until the party winds down. If you miss the invite, another party comes around after the next big score, so keep an eye on your messages.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game phone messages
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Vice Squeeze
trophies.description: Share a quiet moment with your partner between jobs.
trophies.guide: Between story missions, Lucia and Jason can spend downtime together — a drive, a meal, or just sitting on the safehouse porch. Trigger one of these quiet moments from the phone or by visiting the right spot with your partner. The trophy pops during the scene; it is a story-flavoured moment, not a minigame.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: The Hard Call
trophies.description: Choose Lucia's plan for the final heist.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE: at the planning stage of the final heist you must choose between Lucia's plan and Jason's plan. This trophy requires picking Lucia's plan and completing the heist that way. The other plan has its own outcome but no trophy, so save manually before the planning board and reload if you chose wrong. The trophy pops when the heist is complete.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game trophy list, PlayStation 5
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: First Wheels
trophies.description: Buy your first car in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Open the car listings on your phone, pick any vehicle you can afford, and buy it — the car is delivered to your safehouse garage. Even the cheapest used car counts. The trophy pops on purchase, and the car is yours to keep, customise and race.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game phone listings
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website

trophies.name: Home Sweet Home
trophies.description: Buy a safehouse property in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Property listings appear on your phone once the story opens up the market. Buy any safehouse — a beach apartment, a Keys shack or a Vice City flat — and the trophy pops. Safehouses give you a bed, a garage and a wardrobe, so this one pays for itself immediately.
sources: Grand Theft Auto VI in-game property listings
Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI official website
